task_description: Create panicStop (alias: ps) command - automated market exit when ticket/trade flow shows zero activity for specified duration. Server-side execution for minimal latency. Visual timer indicator in trades tape for debugging.

command_registration.description: COMMANDS array with Cmd { name, aliases } structure. match_command() resolves aliases to canonical names.

pipe_integration.description: execute_pending_action() handles piped commands, receives side from PendingAction struct.

trailing_stop_pattern.description: set_trailing_stop() shows parsing of Value::Percent vs Value::Absolute, uses position side from argument or finds position.

payload_handler.description: SetTrailingStop handler pattern - match payload, call bybit method, return ServerMessage

trade_updates.description: Chart event handling - receives WsEvent::TradeUpdate, parses trades, sends ServerPayload::TradeUpdate. Use this pattern to reset panic stop timer.

trades_tape_ui.description: draw_trades_tape() uses ListItem with Line::from(vec![Span...]) pattern, shows time/side/qty

protocol_messages.description: Uses #[serde(tag = "type", content = "data")] for enum serialization. Dedicated Request structs for complex payloads like TrailingStopRequest.

market_order.description: place_order() with reduce_only flag, position_idx for hedge mode (1=Long, 2=Short). Use for panic sell execution.

trailing_stop.description: TrailingStop is the closest existing feature - activates on trigger price, executes trailing order. PanicStop will have similar structure but monitors activity instead of price movement.

trade_flow.description: Trade updates flow: bybit_ws -> server (parse_trade) -> client (TradeUpdate) -> app.trades deque. Use this to reset panic stop timer on each trade.

pending_action.description: PendingAction holds symbol, side, action string. Created when pipe | is used. Executed when position appears via execute_pending_action().

type_constraints.decimal: rust_decimal::Decimal for all prices and quantities
type_constraints.symbol: trade_shared::Symbol wrapper around String, use Symbol::new()
type_constraints.side: trade_shared::Side enum (Buy, Sell), serializes to lowercase
